message: Hi Jane, I hope you're doing well. I was wondering if there are any updates on the Willow Park fundraiser? I heard it was a great success and I'd love to know more about it!
Jane, don't forget about the meeting tomorrow at 10 AM. We need to finalize the budget allocation.
Reminder: Volunteer gathering this Saturday at 4 PM. Let's make a difference together!
Jane, the new brochures have arrived. Can you stop by to check them out?
Good morning Jane, I've transferred the photos from the event to the shared drive.
Hey, can you send me the contact info for the caterer you used for the fundraiser? Thanks!
Don't miss out on our yoga class this Wednesday at 7 PM at the community center!
Jane, the report on last quarter's community outreach programs is ready for review.
I've updated the volunteer list. Let me know if there are any changes needed.
Book club this Friday at 6 PM. This month's read: 'The Midnight Library'.
